chapter: Road bands: Hucklebuck Williams and Tiny Bradshaw
title: Quitting and joining Tiny Bradshaw's band through Red Prysock
summary: Sam quits Hucklebuck's band and is recruited outside the Hotel Theresa by Red Prysock for Tiny Bradshaw's thirty-five-night tour.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So he--so man, me and the rhythm section, me and Joe Booker--that was the drummer--and Lee Anderson-- the piano player--well we're saying "Whereis this son-of- we're down there with all this back-beat and a-gun, man?" We're tired, boy, / stuff and all this rhythm and the horns, they riffing and riffing and sweat just rolling all--man, I say 'man, the--wait til I see this sucker, man, I'm going to punch him in the mouth if he don't come back in here," you know. This cat stayed out there for a long time, man. Then it--after a while we heard him coming back and he looking at me laughing, you know. He was looking at me and smiling. Said now this dude here, boy, you better not tell me nothing funny. And so when we got through after that it was intermission. He say--and when it was intermission he said--"hey Sam, I want to tell you something. You know when I was sitting on the outside on the stoop listening at you dumb suckers in there," he said, "I was sitting in there --you're some dumb niggers, you know, just sitting in there, sitting in there making all that noise in there. I'm sitting out there on the stoop listening at you all." I said "oh, man," I had to quit the band then. So I was standing in front of the Teresa Hotel. And Red Prysock came by there. Said, "man, we been looking for you. Where the devil you been?" I said, "what you mean, looking for me?" He said, "man, we--we go uh, uh, we want you to join the

band--Tiny Bradshaw's band." I say "Tiny--Tiny Bradshaw?" He say "do you have a gig?" I said "no I don't have a gig." He said "do you want--do you want--do you want to join the band?" I say "shit--hell yeah, man." And so "you see what--we open tonight in Maryland. We getting ready to go on a tour, man. We got thirty-five one-nighters." I said "thirty five one nighters, damn." So I said "OK, will you--uh, if you take me by my house, you know, and let me get a bag." He said, "come on." So he took me by my house--I lived up on 150th Street. I lived with my folks.
